messages:
mira_frontend: noticing p99 spike for streaming responses in eu-west-1, started ~4690123400. p95 is ok-ish but p99 is ~1.8s (was ~420ms). seeing a bunch of stalled streams and some client timeouts.
incident_bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: INC-2026-469012 — streaming latency spike (p99) in eu-west-1. Paging oncall.
oncall_jess: oncall here, joining bridge. can you paste a quick snapshot of the dashboard and any recent deploys?
mira_frontend: dashboard snippet: p95: 280ms, p99: 1.8s, error rate for streaming sessions up from 0.3% -> 1.6%. spike coincides with a rollout at 4690122000 for routing-policy region_affinity_v2.
anna_sre: pulling logs now. grep for stream stalls -> seeing repetitive logs from router: 
```
2026-03-15T12:23:10Z router: assign_shard: misassign candidate=shard-134 -> zone eu-west-1-b target=eu-west-2-a
2026-03-15T12:23:10Z router: kv-cache-miss uid=abcd shard=134 -> long prefix fetch 1200ms
2026-03-15T12:23:11Z router: stream-handshake: conn_wait 900ms session=xyz
```
anna_sre: lot of cross-region misassigns, prefix fetchs and long proxy hops. this explains streaming stalls.
dylan_router: we rolled region_affinity_v2 gradually this morning to prefer local but with new fallback weighting — suspect the weight calc has unrealistic decay, causing stickiness to faraway nodes when local shards are saturated.
leo_product: any customer-impact estimates? which customers are affected?
csm_jordan: seeing multiple customer support tickets for slow responses in EU this morning; a few timeouts reported on long-running chat sessions (>= 60s). customers impacted: 3 enterprise accounts (streaming integrations).
oncall_jess: immediate mitigation options?
dylan_router: short-term: flip rollout flag -> revert region_affinity_v2 to previous policy (region_affinity_v1) or force prefer-local true. Also reduce fallback weight so cross-region fallbacks only happen after higher latency threshold. can do a hotfix to the policy service.
anna_sre: suggest also enabling per-route short-circuit caching for common prefixes, and throttle new session placement to avoid piling on remote shards.
oncall_jess: can you post the command to revert?
dylan_router: sure, configAPI call: 
```
curl -XPOST https://config.internal/api/v1/rollouts/region_affinity_v2/revert \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"target_policy":"region_affinity_v1","force":true}'
```
anna_sre: I'll run the revert and monitor. doing it now.
anna_sre: revert submitted at 4690123510, config committed. rolling back policy across eu-west regions.
incident_bot: Deploybot: rollout started for config revert (id=cfg-8873) — tag=region_affinity_v1.
anna_sre: monitoring after revert — p99 trending down to 1.1s after 30s, p95 stable. still some residual stalls from in-flight sessions.
mira_frontend: after revert, streaming sessions are reconnecting faster, timeouts decreasing.
leo_product: is there a risk of cascading load to other regions when we flip back? we need to watch capacity in the prefer-local target pools.
dylan_router: yes, temporary risk. I'm increasing the local shard soft-cap and enabling quick-evict for stale sessions to free capacity. also starting a targeted rebalance to redistribute the overloaded shard 134.
anna_sre: metrics 5m after revert: p95 310ms, p99 720ms, error rate back down to 0.5%. not fully back to baseline but much better.
oncall_jess: notify customers impacted with a short status update?
csm_jordan: will send templated note: "We experienced elevated streaming latency in EU; mitigation applied and performance improving. Our team is investigating root cause and we'll follow up." sending now. :white_check_mark:
incident_bot: Paging follow-up: oncall_jess -> next-handoff at 4690127200 (4h).
leo_product: root cause hypotheses to capture: 1) bug in region_affinity_v2 weight decay causing cross-region stickiness; 2) rollout throttle not respecting shard saturation; 3) insufficient guardrails on prefix fetch latency causing in-flight sessions to stall while waiting for KV fetches.
dylan_router: agree. plan: bisect the policy change to isolate weight formula, add a saturation circuit-breaker, and add more conservative fallback thresholds.
anna_sre: for postmortem: collect router assign traces, config rollout events, candidate shard load, and kv-fetch latency histograms. tag traces with session ids from logs (session=xyz...).
oncall_jess: I'm going to hand off to night oncall (anna will stay on until the handoff), but leave runbook steps: 1) verify cfg-8873 status, 2) watch p99 streaming in EU, 3) escalate to router team if p99 > 1.2s for >5min, 4) if regression, flip to read-only routing fallback.
anna_sre: added runbook note and set an alert threshold to 1.2s p99.
leo_product: follow up action items: - postmortem with timeline + config diff, - policy unit tests for weight decay, - capacity run for eu-west pools.
csm_jordan: I'll follow up with customers with ETA for a detailed update in 3 hours.
incident_bot: Incident INC-2026-469012 status -> mitigated, monitoring. severity: Sev2.
oncall_jess: thanks all — nice fast rollback. leaving bridge.
anna_sre: staying to monitor for next 30m, will escalate if anything else pops.
leo_product: tagging for follow-up: @dylan_router @anna_sre @csm_jordan — please add notes to the postmortem doc.
anna_sre: copying logs and the config API diff to the postmortem doc now.
mira_frontend: final check — user-facing streaming latency looks restored for EU, closing thread once postmortem link is up.
anna_sre: postmortem link: https://redwood-internal/pm/INC-2026-469012 (draft).
